acceptance: Trusted state proves which workflow revision produced it (for example the workflow blob sha recorded in the state and checked against develop)
A test covers a retarget that happens before the run is created
description: github._pull_request_target_trusted accepts a run when the pull request's base is develop and its latest base_ref_changed event predates the run's created_at. That proves only the base when the run record was created, not which workflow file ran. A user with write access could retarget to a branch with a modified oracle-review-shadow.yml and back before the run is created (timestamps have one-second resolution), and the forged state artifact would be trusted. The run path carries no workflow ref. Deferred twice as Medium on #2769.
